scope: SECCA release runtime verification without model inference; separate from recorded model experiments
runtime_change: MCP smoke client uses 127.0.0.1 rather than localhost so it works with --no-hosts and --network none. Vendored MCP source is unchanged.
reproduce: uv run --frozen python scripts/verify_runtime.py --connection CONNECTION --image localhost/kart-sbx-secca:v0.1.0 --output NEW_DIRECTORY
limitations: The smoke fixture does not generate or score a model's CAD output.
A new build can resolve different Debian transitive packages and produce a different image ID.
Native CAD, STEP, and PNG bytes are recorded for this run; future runs are not required to reproduce these artifact bytes.
The checked-in summary records the local verification. Re-run the helper to produce raw command evidence and smoke artifacts.
These checks do not establish a complete denial-of-service boundary.
